verdict.rationale: The CRA handles taxpayers' personal and business data through its online services, so a policy or control on AI-training use of that data is a fair question. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions an AI-training opt-out, a data-use policy, or any related privacy control. The cited items cover business registration, e-services, EFILE and a missing llms.txt, none of which address this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
